description: Territoire à Risque d'Inondation (TRI) de Noirmoutier - Saint-Jean-de-Monts - Enjeux liés à une station de traitement des eaux usées is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by assainissement.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Geographical data set produced by the GIS Directive on flooding of the territory at significant risk of flooding (TRI) of NOIRMOUTIER ST-JEAN-DE-MONTS European Directive 2007/60/EC of 23 October 2007 on the assessment and management of flood risks (OJ L 288, 06-11-2007, p. 27) influences the flood prevention strategy in Europe. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Territory at Flood Risk (TRI) of Noirmoutier - Saint-Jean-de-Monts - Issues related to a wastewater treatment plant" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Sols, cartographie, Sites protégés, directive inondation, gestion du risque d’inondation, RISQUE/N_INONDATION. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
